description: This file is a shell script for testing Git repository selection logic, including functions to create repositories, perform fetch and clone operations, and verify outcomes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes directories used for testing Git repositories to reset the environment.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository in a directory and makes an initial commit.

methods.name: make_bare
methods.description: Creates a bare Git repository with an initial commit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches from a remote repository and clones it into a new directory.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that the fetched and cloned repositories contain the expected commit message.
